verdict.rationale: Rootly documents two-way chat-ops in Slack and Microsoft Teams: you can declare, run, and resolve incidents there, and acknowledge, escalate, and resolve pages from Teams. Jira appears as a workflow action category and as an AI connector that can search and read issues, but bidirectional Jira state sync is not documented. Zoom and GitHub are not named as integrations. missing for 10: documented bidirectional Jira sync, a named Zoom integration, a named GitHub integration, independent hands-on corroboration of state flowing both ways.

support.subject: As an SRE, the platform integrates with the tools around the incident — Jira, Slack, Teams, Zoom, GitHub — so state flows both ways
